combinations.magnitude: circ_0005075 reversed the repressive effect of miR-151a-3p; abstract only
combinations.evidence_quote: We displayed that miR-151a-3p was greatly reduced in CCI rats and circ_0005075 reversed the repressive effect of miR-151a-3p on neuropathic pain.

combinations.magnitude: circ_0005075 rescued NOTCH2 expression repressed by miR-151a-3p; abstract only
combinations.evidence_quote: In addition, circ_0005075 significantly rescued NOTCH2 expression, which could be repressed by miR-151a-3p.
